candidates.quote: Rated short-time withstand current Ik shall be 31.5 kA RMS for a duration of 3 s.
Main busbars shall be electrolytic copper Cu-ETP rated for 2000 A continuous current.
Enclosure protection shall be IP54 with internal arc classification IAC AFLR.

Protection IEDs shall communicate via IEC 61850 Edition 2 with PRP redundancy, with pre-wired RTU
marshalling in a central marshalling cabinet.

A 3-day witnessed integrated factory acceptance test (I-FAT) with primary injection shall be included in the
contract price.
Delivery shall be DDP project site Rogaland (Incoterms 2020).
The defect liability period shall be 24 months from commissioning.
Rated voltage Ur shall be not less than 36 kV.
Equipment shall be rated for a maximum ambient air temperature of +45 °C without derating.

tender_facts.quote: The switchgear lineup comprises 7 bays (1 incomer, 1 bus coupler, 5 feeders) of gas-insulated switchgear.
